dataset: Per-instance outputs of HELM Classic release v0.4.0 (Stanford CRFM): every synthetic_reasoning run listed in runs_to_run_suites.json, test split, all trials.
note: Classes of HELM's quasi-exact credits: exact (exact_match 1); format_only (same tokens: case, spacing, other punctuation, articles); ops_misplaced (the gold's operators in the gold's order but in other places); ops_blind (audit 99's operator-blind credits). pattern_exact = exact + format_only. Cells: mean of a model's trial-level means over the three modes.
